findings.location: Blue primary buttons (+ Add More, Enhance Resume, Change Layout)
findings.issue: The white text on the bright blue background (#007bff) of the action buttons does not meet the minimum WCAG AA contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text.
findings.recommendation: Darken the blue background color to at least #0056b3 or use darker text to ensure the contrast ratio meets or exceeds 4.5:1.

findings.location: Delete ('x') buttons in Skills and Certifications sections
findings.issue: The delete ('x') buttons are positioned on a completely separate line below the inputs instead of being placed inline, resulting in a broken and confusing layout.
findings.recommendation: Align each delete button horizontally on the right side of its corresponding input field to visually associate the action with the specific field.

findings.location: Chatbot input field and send button
findings.issue: The circular send icon overlaps the text input field, causing typed text to run underneath the button and become unreadable.
findings.recommendation: Increase the right padding of the text input area so that typed text wraps before hitting the send icon, or place the send icon outside the input field container.

findings.issue: The 'Experience' input field does not feature a delete button, unlike the 'Skills' and 'Certifications' sections, creating functional inconsistency across repeating lists.
findings.recommendation: Provide individual delete buttons consistently across all repeatable input fields across all form sections.
